requirements.title: Periodic Full-Store Consistency GC Run
requirements.description: [PLANNED/DEFERRED] Execute a scheduled, store-wide garbage-collection and consistency pass separate from the per-query reconcile step. The GC run: (1) identifies findings that have been in superseded status beyond the configurable retention period and permanently archives them (moves to a cold archive table); (2) prunes fully decayed findings (confidence below minimum threshold and zero effectiveness for the full decay window); (3) identifies and resolves simple consistency anomalies (e.g., orphaned findings with no brief reference). GC runs are logged with a full report of actions taken.

validation.notes: GC run identifies superseded findings older than the retention threshold and reports them as cold-archive candidates [criterion revised from auto-generated 'moves them to cold archive table' wording: by design (DECISIONS.md — findings are never hard-deleted and the GC never mutates beyond the confidence-gated supersede) there is no cold-archive table and no automatic move; the GC reports ColdArchiveCandidates and the operator-invoked `findings prune` is the only delete path]
GC run identifies findings with confidence below minimum threshold AND zero effectiveness and marks them for pruning
GC run identifies orphaned findings (brief_id references non-existent brief) and flags them
GC run produces a structured report listing counts of each action type taken
GC dry-run mode reports intended actions without mutating the database
Seed database with expired superseded findings, decayed zero-effectiveness findings, and orphaned findings; run GC; verify each category is handled correctly and report is generated
Verify that active findings with recent effectiveness events are not touched by the GC run
GC run over a 100,000-finding database completes within 5 minutes
The findings database does not grow unboundedly; stale and unresolvable findings are periodically cleaned up to maintain store quality and query performance
